name: Tay Ninh
provinceNote: Resolution 202/2025/QH15, passed 12 June 2025, joined old Long An and old Tây Ninh and kept the name Tây Ninh: 8,536.44 km² and 3,254,170 people, beside Đồng Nai, Đồng Tháp, Ho Chi Minh City, and Cambodia. The new provincial government started 1 July 2025. Resolution 1682 counts 96 communes, 82 xã and 14 phường. This night is the Holy See and Ba Den. The former Long An towns are a separate trip.
dotReason: The noon service and the next morning’s cable are the reason to stay.
summary: A province northwest of Ho Chi Minh City, home to the Cao Dai Holy See and Ba Den Mountain. Watch the noon service at the Cao Dai temple, ride the cable car up Ba Den, and eat dew-dried rice paper rolls at Trang Bang. Two days and one night suits culture and faith travellers.
fee: Holy See ticket: Check on arrival. From 16 February 2026 through 3 May 2026, and again from 28 September 2026 through 31 December 2026: gate 10,000 đồng adult and 5,000 child; Vân Sơn 450,000 and 350,000; Chùa Hang round trip 250,000 and 150,000; Tâm An 450,000 and 350,000. Under 1 m is free. From 1 m to under 1.4 m is the child fare. From 1.4 m is adult. After 17:00, on the 28 September–31 December notice only: Vân Sơn 300,000 and 200,000, Chùa Hang round trip 150,000 and 100,000, Tâm An 300,000 and 200,000. The 18–26 June 2026 window listed a Chùa Bà cable of 125,000 and a summit combo of 450,000 and 350,000. That window is closed. An everyday fare for the second cable company: Check on arrival. Hồ Dầu Tiếng ticket: Check on arrival.
getThere: About 100 km from Ho Chi Minh City, about 110 km northwest to Ba Den, or about 90 km to more than 100 km from Tân Sơn Nhất to the city centre. A mountain-first road can exceed 110 km. The drive is about 2.5 to 3 hours. A 2018 account gives about 100 km from Sài Gòn to the valley, then about 50 km on tỉnh lộ 782. The Holy See is about 4 km southeast of the old city. Ba Den is a little more than 10 km from the centre, and 11 km northeast. Hồ Dầu Tiếng’s shore is about 20 km from the city. Coach fare, minutes from the kerb, and minutes between the temple and the mountain: Check on arrival. No train.
seoTitle: Tay Ninh travel guide — Cao Dai noon service and Ba Den
seoDescription: The noon service in the Cao Dai Holy See courtyard, then the first cable up Ba Den. Sleep in Tân Ninh, or nearer the gate in Bình Minh.
intro: You stand in the courtyard of the Cao Dai Holy See at noon, under the long pale front, the bell tower, and the drum tower. The Divine Eye is a detail on that front. Ba Den is the ridge for the first cable the next morning. Stay the night in phường Tân Ninh, the old city centre, if that noon service and the first cabin are the trip. Sleep nearer the gate in phường Bình Minh if you want that first cabin. The night is the forecourt at the 18:00 service, in phường Long Hoa, or the mountain after 17:00, when the cable fare is lower. Go back to Ho Chi Minh City if the city is the trip. Cu Chi is a different night.

Walk the court and look into the prayer hall at a service. The plan is a dragon-horse. The hall is 97.5 m by 22 m. Twelve carved gates face the court. Noon is the service to see. Dress is modest. Shoes come off. Men take the right door. Women take the left door. Daily services are also 0:00, 6:00, and 18:00. The four together are cúng tứ thời. One visit length is about 60 minutes. The temple is about 4 km southeast of the old city, in phường Long Hoa. The mountain office, khu phố Ninh Phú, phường Bình Minh, is not this door.

Work started in 1931, and also in 1933. It was completed on 24 January 1947, also given as completed in 1947, and the work is also given as finished in 1955. Inauguration is 1 February 1955, and also 1955. The grounds are more than 1 km², nearly 100 ha, and about 1 km². The canopy has 3,027 stars and 3,072 globes. Chí Tôn day is the 9th of lunar January, and also the 8th, with more than 30,000 people. On 25 September 2026 the Mother Goddess flower procession was at 18:30 and the great rite at 22:00.

Ba Den is the other half of the stay, a little more than 10 km from the city centre and 11 km northeast of the old town. The height is 986 m, called nóc nhà Nam Bộ, with núi Heo at 335 m and núi Phụng at 660 m. The complex is about 24 km². The 1986 landscape reserve is nearly 2,000 ha, Decision 194/CT of 9 August 1986. A 1,200 m cable and a slide of 1,190 m up and 1,700 m down are named. The 2026 lines are Vân Sơn to the summit, Chùa Hang toward the Bà temples, and Tâm An. On the summit a 72 m copper Phật Bà weighs 170 tons, and a sandstone Di Lặc is 36 m high, 45 m wide, of 6,688 blocks. Ba Den Station is 10,959 m². Recognition is Decision 100-VH/QĐ and 100/VH-QĐ, both dated 21 January 1989. The war unit is Hậu cần 82 and also Hậu cần 32. Liên đội 7 is on both. The caves on the mountain are not the Cu Chi tunnels.

The clock in force on 22 October 2026 is the 28 September 2026 notice, until a later notice. Monday to Friday, Vân Sơn and Chùa Hang run 06:00–20:30. Tâm An does not run those days. The spiritual area is 06:30–20:00. Saturday, Vân Sơn and Chùa Hang run 05:30–21:00, Tâm An 06:30–19:00, and the spiritual area 06:00–20:30. Sunday, Vân Sơn and Chùa Hang run 05:30–20:30, Tâm An 06:30–19:00, and the spiritual area 06:00–20:00. The gate is open one hour before the cable and one hour after. The buffet is 10:00–15:00. An earlier clock is 6:00–20:00 on Monday and Friday and 5:30–21:00 on weekends and holidays, and does not name Tuesday to Thursday. On that earlier clock the last ride up is often 30 minutes before close. Weather can stop the cable. A second company, on 24–27 September 2026, listed a tube slide at 07:30–18:00 and a cable at 07:30–16:00.

Hồ Dầu Tiếng is the sunset once the temple and the mountain are planned. The water is given as “diện tích mặt nước 27 km”, a catchment of 27,000 ha, and up to 1.58 billion m³, and also 270 km² and 1.58 billion m³, and also 27,000 ha and 1.5 billion m³. The shore is about 20 km from the city. Ma Thiên Lãnh is a walk between Ba Den, Phụng, and Heo to a green stone lake on the west foot of núi Heo. It is a quarry pool, not a swim, and people have carried lunch because there was no food stall. Chùa Gò Kén, also Chùa Thiền Lâm, is more than 100 years old and the earliest built in Tây Ninh. Do not swap it with the Holy See or with Chùa Bà on the mountain. Gạo Nàng Thơm Chợ Đào, thanh long Đức Hòa, rượu đế Gò Đen, cá lóc nướng trui, lẩu mắm, and khô cá lóc belong to the old Long An half. They are a different lunch from the Holy See.
gettingAround: The nearest airport is Tân Sơn Nhất, in Ho Chi Minh City. No passenger airport sits inside Tây Ninh. No rail station is on the road in. Do not plan a train.

The road leaves Tân Sơn Nhất toward Cộng Hòa, then Quốc lộ 22, through Trảng Bàng and Gò Dầu, into the city, and on to the mountain if that is the first stop. Another approach uses Quốc lộ 22A to the Trảng Bàng junction, then tỉnh lộ 782. Ho Chi Minh City is about 100 km away. Ba Den is about 110 km northwest. From the airport the city centre is about 90 km to more than 100 km, a first stop at the mountain can exceed 110 km, and the drive is about 2.5 to 3 hours. The valley is about 100 km from Sài Gòn, then about 50 km on tỉnh lộ 782. That 50 km is not the 90 km to more than 100 km. Old phường 2 is inside phường Tân Ninh from 1 July 2025.

The Holy See is about 4 km southeast of the old city, in phường Long Hoa. The mountain is a little more than 10 km from the city centre, and 11 km northeast. From 1 July 2025 the old city centre is phường Tân Ninh, old Long Hoa stays inside phường Long Hoa, and old Thạnh Tân and old Ninh Sơn are inside phường Bình Minh. The mountain office is khu phố Ninh Phú, phường Bình Minh. That line is not the temple’s door. On the way in, Trảng Bàng sits on Quốc lộ 22. Địa đạo An Thới is named there. That is not the Cu Chi site.

eat: The meal on the way in is bánh tráng phơi sương at Trảng Bàng, rolled with boiled pork or boiled young beef. Bánh canh, bò tơ, and muối tôm are the other Trảng Bàng plates. Bún Xiêm Lo is the border bowl. Lẩu mắm, Nàng Thơm Chợ Đào rice, and dried snakehead are the old Long An half, not lunch at the Holy See.
interestsBody: Dining is the Trảng Bàng roll, bánh canh, and bò tơ on the way in. Muối tôm is the jar. Bún Xiêm Lo is the border bowl. The old Long An half is a different meal.
The Holy See is the Cao Dai central temple in phường Long Hoa, with four daily services. Noon is the one to see. It is not a pagoda row, and it is not a wing of the Cu Chi tunnels.
Ba Den, at 986 m, is the cable day. The lake at dusk is Hồ Dầu Tiếng. Ma Thiên Lãnh is the walk on the same hills. Chùa Gò Kén is a short stop on the plain.

Sheets from khu phố Lộc Du, and muối tôm, are what you carry from Chợ Trảng Bàng. Zone-I points on the mountain, including Liên đội 7, are the war layer. Hậu cần 82 and Hậu cần 32 are both given. This is not Cu Chi.

The same center speaks of bún Xiêm Lo at breakfast or at lunch, and does not name the commune. Mãng cầu Bà Đen is the fruit at the mountain. Lẩu mắm and Nàng Thơm Chợ Đào rice stay on the old Long An half.

blocks.heading: Chợ Trảng Bàng
paragraphs: Chợ Trảng Bàng, on the way in along Quốc lộ 22, is where you buy bánh tráng phơi sương and a jar of muối tôm. The sheets are made in khu phố Lộc Du and eaten in khu phố Gia Huỳnh, rolled with boiled pork or boiled young beef.
Bánh canh and bò tơ are the sit-down plates on that same strip, in phường Trảng Bàng and phường An Tịnh. The jar and the rice paper are what you carry.

faqs.q: Should I stay the night in Tay Ninh or come back to Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Stay if you want the noon service and the first cable the next morning. Ho Chi Minh City is about 100 km, Ba Den about 110 km northwest, and the airport road about 90 km to more than 100 km, with a mountain-first road that can exceed 110 km and a drive of about 2.5 to 3 hours. The valley is about 100 km, then about 50 km. Go back the same day only if Ho Chi Minh City is the trip. Cu Chi is not this night.

faqs.q: Is there a ticket for the Holy See, and how long is the visit?
faqs.a: No ticket is listed. One visit length is about 60 minutes. The temple is about 4 km southeast of the old city. Shoes come off. Men take the right door. Women take the left door.

faqs.q: Which Ba Den cable clock applies, and what does the ride cost?
faqs.a: On 22 October 2026 the notice in force is the 28 September 2026 clock, until a later notice: weekdays Vân Sơn and Chùa Hang 06:00–20:30, Saturday 05:30–21:00, Sunday 05:30–20:30. An earlier clock is 6:00–20:00 on Monday and Friday and 5:30–21:00 on weekends and holidays, and does not name Tuesday to Thursday. The round-trip cables on the September–December notice are Vân Sơn 450,000 and 350,000, Chùa Hang 250,000 and 150,000, Tâm An 450,000 and 350,000, plus a gate of 10,000 and 5,000. After 17:00 those cables are lower on that notice. The 18–26 June festival prices are a closed window.

season.label: Dry Dec–Apr
season.note: December to April is the easier time on Hồ Dầu Tiếng, at dawn and dusk, and the dry walk at Ma Thiên Lãnh. August to November the valley path is slippery. Lunar January is the spring festival on Ba Den, from the 4th through the end of that lunar month. Lunar days 4, 5, and 6 of the fifth month are the Bà pilgrimage, and those days fill the cable. In 2026 the windows were 18–20 June, 18–22 June, and 18–21 June. The cable clock can change in bad weather.
